dedupe_keys.name: uav surveying water tower inside a school

description: João Martins, Marcelo Petry and António Paulo Moreira at INESC TEC and FEUP publish sensor observations from a drone survey of a water tower inside a school. The June 2023 deposit includes Ouster OS1-128 LiDAR, a 1280-by-960 camera with a 145-degree field of view, three inertial measurement units, and GPS and RTK positions and velocities. ROS bag files are offered in a ZIP archive alongside calibration text and sensor metadata, free under CC BY 4.0. Intrinsic and extrinsic sensor parameters support registration and navigation experiments. These observations can help test inspection trajectories or reconstruct asset geometry for simulation. The site country, flight date, duration and measurement accuracy remain unknown from the description. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this survey. Sensor streams were not downloaded, so synchronisation and calibration quality were not independently checked.
